name: Homeowner - image service offered selectively
description: Homeowner who seems unsure should be offered the image/photo service. AI should mention they can send a photo for help with measurements/sketch.

messages.text: Hi, I want to build some cabinets for my garage but I really don't know what I need. Never done this before.

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
AI should offer the photo/image service to an unsure homeowner
